Its premium Maharani label includes Basmati Rice 1121, Royal Basmati and Supreme Basmati, while other basmati brands include Mithas, Begum and Nezzah. Mr. Chaman Lal Setia founded it in 1974, and its main office is in New Delhi.

DEEDEV.NS.d: DEE Development Engineers Ltd. was established in 1988 and has its head office in Faridabad, India. It manufactures prefabricated engineering solutions, pipe fittings and piping systems internationally, with Piping, Power and Heavy Fabrication segments, including high-pressure piping systems.

GANDHAR.NS.d: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited, set up in 1992, with its head office in Mumbai, mainly produces white oils for consumer and healthcare customers across India. It works through Specialty Oil, Non-coking Coal and Logistics Support Services divisions, and its products also include waxes and jellies.

GANESHBE.NS.d: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited is a Mumbai-based company established in 1986 that makes and distributes industrial lubricants, food preservatives and specialty chemicals. It has two divisions: Liquid Storage Terminal, which provides storage and handling, and Chemical.

GANGESSECU.NS.d: Ganges Securities Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the tea and investment business primarily in India. It is involved in tea plantation, manufacturing, and processing activities; and invests and deals in shares, securities, and immovable properties. The company also engages in rental and leasing activities. Ganges Securities Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

GLOBE.NS.d: Globe Textiles (India) Limited manufactures and trades in textile and apparel products in India and internationally. The company offers denim and non-denim fabrics; shirting fabrics, such as printed linens, suiting prints, and dyed shirting fabrics; printed fabrics, including polyester print fabrics, chadri voiles, sarongs, scarfs, polyester dyed fabrics, cotton prints, and cotton dyed fabrics; and jeans for men and women under the Afford, INDIGIRL, and INDIGEN brand names.

GLOBECIVIL.NS.d: Globe Civil Projects Limited operates mainly in India's civil construction sector through two segments: Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) and Trading. The EPC segment carries out infrastructure and non-infrastructure projects, with infrastructure work covering roads, bridges and terminal facilities.

GUJTHEM.NS.d: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd. is an Indian company that produces pharmaceuticals and medicinal chemicals and supplies bulk drugs through job work. Its products include Rifamycin-S, an intermediate used in treatments for tuberculosis and leprosy, Rifamycin-O, used for conditions like traveler's diarrhea, and Lovastatin. Established in 1981, it is based in Mumbai.

HBESD.NS.d: HB Estate Developers Limited focuses on real estate development. The company is engaged in developing residential and commercial properties. HB Estate Developers Limited is based in India.

HINDCOMPOS.NS.d: Hindustan Composites Limited develops, manufactures, and markets fiber based friction materials in India. The company offers friction materials, including automotive brake linings, automotive and industrial roll linings, automotive clutch facings and ceramic buttons, automotive disc brake pads, railway brake blocks, and friction sheets. It also provides industrial thrust bearing and insulation products comprising millboard sheets, millboard discs, compestos, and compestos rings.

HINDUNILVR.NS.d: Hindustan Unilever Limited, a consumer goods company, manufactures and sells home and personal care, food, and refreshment products in India and internationally. The company operates through Home Care, Beauty & Personal Care, Foods & Refreshment, and Others segments. The Home Care segment offers detergent bars and powders, detergent liquids, scourers, water business, etc.

INM.NS.d: Interiors & More Ltd. is a design-centric company that manufactures, trades, and exports artificial décor solutions for residential, commercial, and event-based styling needs. Their product portfolio includes artificial flowers, plants, greenery, vases, planters, candleware, decorative lights, chandeliers, fragrances, and banquet furniture.

IRISDOREME.NS.d: Iris Clothings Limited engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of kids wear in India. It offers tops, T-shirts, pants, shorts, frocks, dresses, and towels for infants, boys, girls, women, and men under the DoReMe brand name. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Howrah, India.

JPOLYINVST.NS.d: Jindal Poly Investment and Finance Company Limited engages in investment activities in India. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

JSFB.NS.d: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited offers banking and financial services in India to individuals and businesses. Its segments are treasury, corporate and wholesale banking, retail banking, and other operations. It provides current, savings and deposit accounts, loans for two-wheelers, businesses, gold and homes, insurance products, cards, investment and payment services, and digital banking.

KAKATCEM.NS.d: Kakatiya Cement Sugar and Industries Limited manufactures and sells Portland cement in India. The company operates through three segments: Cement, Sugar, and Power. It also produces and sells sugar; and owns and operates a 17 megawatt cogeneration power plant. The company was formerly known as Kakatiya Cements Limited. Kakatiya Cement Sugar and Industries Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

KALAMANDIR.NS.d: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited is an apparel retailer in India selling ultra-premium and high-quality sarees for weddings, parties and daily wear, plus ethnic fashion for middle-income shoppers. Its value segment covers fusion and Western wear and lehengas for women, men and children. It trades from several store formats, such as Kalamandir and KLM Fashion Mall. It was founded in 2005.

KEYFINSERV.NS.d: Keynote Financial Services Limited provides investment banking and brokerage services in India. It offers capital market services, which include IPO/rights issue services, such as valuation reports, conducting the due diligence, assessing the fund requirement, market making, underwriting the issue, and lead managing; and merchant banking and advisory services, such as buybacks, delisting, and tender offers.

KWIL.NS.d: Kwality Wall's (India) Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker KWIL and traded in INR. It is classified in the Consumer Staples sector. Its country is India.

MADHAVIPL.NS.d: Madhav Infra Projects Limited is an infrastructure development company involved in construction of roads, highways, and other infrastructure projects. The company undertakes projects on engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) basis, as well as build-operate-transfer (BOT) basis. The company is based in India.

MCCHRLS-B.NS.d: Mac Charles (India) Limited is involved in the hospitality and real estate business. The company operates hotels and resorts, and also develops and manages real estate properties. Its headquarters are located in Bangalore, India.

MSL.NS.d: Mangalam Seeds Limited is an Indian agricultural company focused on the production, processing, and marketing of various seeds, including hybrid and genetically modified seeds. The company also engages in the processing of oilseeds and trading of agricultural commodities. Based in India, Mangalam Seeds aims to provide quality seeds and agricultural products to farmers.

MWL.NS.d: Mangalam Worldwide Limited produces and distributes stainless steel products, chiefly billets and ingots. Ahmedabad is its base, and it dates from 1942. Its range also includes flat, round, square and hexagonal bars, seamless, ERW, heat exchanger and hydraulic tubes and pipes, and continuous cast billets and forged quality ingots.

NATCOPHARM.NS.d: NATCO Pharma Limited, a pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and markets finished dosage formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). It offers formulations in various therapeutic areas, including cancers of blood, liver, kidney, lung, brain, breast, ovary, etc.; and APIs in various categories, such as oncology, central nervous system, pain management, and CV care.

NAVKARURB.NS.d: Navkar Urbanstructure Limited is an Ahmedabad-based infrastructure and construction company that began operating in 1992. It builds civic infrastructure such as drainage, sewage treatment, pumping stations and water pipelines, and also installs 4G cable networks and constructs power facilities, bridges, dams, roads, bungalows, schools and industrial and commercial complexes.

NEAGI.NS.d: Neelamalai Agro Industries Limited is an Indian company primarily engaged in tea plantation and processing. The company cultivates, manufactures, and sells tea, and is based in India. Their business is focused on the production and distribution of tea products.

NITCO.NS.d: NITCO Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells floor and wall solutions in India. The company operates through two segments, Tiles and Other Related Products; and Real Estate segments. It offers ceramic wall and floor tiles; polished and glazed vitrified tiles; and vitrified DCH, heavy duty, and SST tiles.

PACEDIGITK.NS.d: Pace Digitek Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker PACEDIGITK and traded in INR. Its country is India.

POLYMED.NS.d: Poly Medicure Limited manufactures and sells medical devices in India. It offers infusion devices, such as I.V. cannulas, mid line catheters, needle free connectors, three way stop cocks, I.V. infusion sets, extension lines, T-type extension sets, stylet/mandrin with luer locks, and safety winged infusion sets; and central venous catheters, vial access spikes, measured volume fluid administration sets, and CVP manometers.

POLYPLEX.NS.d: Polyplex Corporation Limited manufactures and sells polyester (PET) films primarily for flexible packaging in India and internationally. The company offers Sarafil base films, including biaxially-oriented (BO) PET films for use in packaging, electrical, and industrial applications; BO polypropylene (PP) films for flexible packaging and other applications; cast PP films for flexible packaging and other applications; blown PP films used in pressure sensitive applications; sustainable films; holographic films; and…

PRIVISCL.NS.d: Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited operates as a specialty oleo chemical manufacturing company in India and internationally. Its oleo chemical products include dimer acids used for making of non-reactive and reactive polyamides; linoleic acid and soya fatty acid used in paints; and distilled fatty acids. The company also provides nutraceutical products comprising tocopherols and sterols used in cosmetic, pharmaceutical, etc.

RACLGEAR.NS.d: RACL Geartech Ltd. makes and sells automotive components worldwide, including gears, shafts and assemblies. It supplies two-wheelers with differential and clutch systems, agricultural machinery with gears and shafts, commercial vehicles with drive shafts and pump drives, and passenger cars with intermediate shafts, ring gears and parking mechanisms, plus parts for e-mobility such as rear axle assemblies.

ROSSARI.NS.d: Rossari Biotech Limited manufactures and sells specialty chemicals in India and internationally. It offers home, personal care and performance chemical products, including soap and detergents; inks, paints, and coatings; ceramics and tiles; pulp and papers; cement; and water treatment solutions.

RRECL.NS.d: RDB Real Estate Constructions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RRECL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SAIPARENT.NS.d: Sai Parenterals Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SAIPARENT and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHILGRAVQ.NS.d: Shilp Gravures Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and supplies rotogravure printing cylinders and related products. They serve the packaging and printing industries with their engraved cylinders. The company is based in India.

SMSPHARMA.NS.d: SMS Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates in India. The company offers anti-ulcer, anti-fungal, anti-migraine, anti-diabetic, erectile dysfunction, antiemetic, antiepileptic, antipsychotic, anti-hypertensive, anti-anginal, anti-viral, urinary antispasmodic, and anti-retroviral APIs. It is also involved in the contract research activities. In addition, the company exports its products.

SOMATEX.NS.d: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited manufactures and sells textile fabrics in India. It offers non denim fabrics, garments, and piece dyed fabrics. The company was formerly known as R.B. Rodda & Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Soma Textiles & Industries Limited in January 1992. Soma Textiles & Industries Limited was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

THEMISMED.NS.d: Themis Medicare Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations for use in various therapeutic areas, such as anti-infective, antimalarial, anti-tuberculosis, cardiology, health and nutrition, oncology, ophthalmology, and pain management. The company was formerly known as Themis Chemicals and changed its name to Themis Medicare Limited in 2001.

TMCV.NS.d: Tata Motors Limited makes commercial vehicles, including utility vehicles, pickup trucks, heavy-duty trucks and buses. Headquartered in Mumbai and established in 2024 as TML Commercial Vehicles Limited, it took its present name in October 2025. It operates in India and South Korea and sells across Africa, Latin America, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the SAARC region.

TTKHLTCARE.NS.d: TTK Healthcare Limited engages in the pharmaceutical, consumer product, medical device, protective device, and food businesses in India and internationally. The company's Pharmaceuticals segment deals in herbal and allopathic formulations in various therapeutic areas for human and veterinary uses.

VIKASECO.NS.d: Vikas EcoTech Limited manufactures and sells specialty additives, and rubber-plastic and polymer compounds in India. It offers specialty additives, including organotin stabilizers, dimethyl tin dichloride, plasticizers, chlorinated paraffin, flame-retardants, and chlorinated polyethylene, as well as epoxidized soyabean oil; and thermoplastic rubber, thermoplastic elastomer, and ethylene vinyl acetate compounds.

VINYLINDIA.NS.d: Vinyl Chemicals (India) Limited engages in the trading of various chemicals in India and internationally. It primarily sells vinyl acetate monomer. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

VMARCIND-ST.NS.d: V Marc India Limited is an Indian apparel company involved in manufacturing and exporting readymade garments. They produce a variety of clothing items for both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

WATERBASE.NS.d: The Waterbase Limited operates as an aquaculture company in India. It produces and trades in shrimp feed, such as IQF, block frozen, and cooked Vannamei, tiger shrimp, and scampi feed; and other feed, as well as farm care products under the Baylife brand. The company also engages in shrimp hatchery activities. It markets its products under the BayWhite, Ultra XL, Tiger Bay XL, and Magnum brands. The company also exports its products to Japan, the United States, Europe, and internationally.

WEWORK.NS.d: WeWork India Management Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker WEWORK and traded in INR. Its country is India.

ZSARACOM.NS.d: Saraswati Commercial (India) Limited is an Indian company engaged in trading and investment activities. The company's operations include trading in various commodities and investing in financial instruments. They are based in India.
